summary: The diff under review (branch fix/csv-formula-injection-reporting-gateway vs origin/main) contains no code changes at all -- only a PROGRESS.md rewrite and a 4-line terminology-guardrail exemption for dated comments in auth-guard.ts. The actual CSV/formula-injection fix this task claims to deliver (csvEscape() prefixing in src/lib/report-export-shared.ts plus the /api/v1/reports/catalog null-orgId 400 alignment) is not present in this diff: it exists as a separate, independently verified commit (4cd3bfea) that lives only on origin/worker/task-20260727-101145-reporting-api-gateway--external-ai-scope (PR #599's own branch), is not an ancestor of this branch, and is not merged to main. Approving and merging this diff as-is would not land the security fix it claims to close out -- it would only add documentation and an unrelated exemption entry while leaving the real report-export-shared.ts vulnerability unresolved on an unreviewed, unmerged branch. This is exactly the self-report-trust gap this review process exists to catch: PROGRESS.md's narrative is accurate about what happened, but the artifact dispatched for review here is not the artifact that fixes the vulnerability.
